cases.prompt: Add rate limiting to our public API: 100 requests per minute per API key.
expectations: Picks an algorithm (token bucket, sliding window) and explains why.
Returns 429 with Retry-After and rate limit headers.
Uses a shared store such as Redis so the limit holds across instances.

cases.prompt: Our Python client hammers a third-party API and gets 429s. Write retry logic.
expectations: Uses exponential backoff with jitter and a maximum number of retries.
Honors the Retry-After header when present.
Only retries retriable responses (429, 5xx), not 4xx client errors.
